claims.text: _method handles initialize, ping, tools/list, resources/list, resources/templates/list, prompts/list, tools/call, resources/read and prompts/get.
_frames yields bounded newline frames up to MAX_JSON_BYTES and yields None for a drained oversized frame.
tools/call dispatches through app.dispatch or app.preview for dry_run and returns isError only for execution failures.
_resource reads guide markdown via descriptor-relative no-follow opens confined under the repository root.
_live_resource serves snapshot through snapshot.build and agent views through app.dispatch without reading projection files.

decision.rule: Change here when MCP method routing, prompt or resource catalogues, frame bounds or dispatch wiring needs to change.
decision.failure: A valid request returns method not found, an oversized frame is accepted, or a live resource reads projection files instead of the verified prefix.

questions.q: Where does the MCP adapter bound newline frames and reject oversized requests?
Where should I change how tools/call handles dry_run preview versus dispatch?
Where can I debug a resources/read failure for a guide or snapshot resource?
